candidates.name: Inter-Co Division 10 (Ohio), Inc.
candidates.partition_evidence: Homepage lists toilet partitions and says the company supplies and installs Division 10 products for general contractors; image labels show Bobrick Privada partitions.
candidates.reason: Commercial Division 10 supply-and-install firm with an Ohio office about 70 miles from Dayton, and it lists Ohio as a service state. Dayton isn't named, and it also distributes partitions, so there is a buy-around risk.
red_flags: Contact page calls the Ohio office a distribution centre; Dayton coverage not stated

license.name: Inter-Co Division 10 (Ohio), Inc.
license.registry: City of Dayton Building Inspection Division, Registered Contractors Lists (electrical, heating, pipe laying, plumbing only); Ohio Construction Industry Licensing Board (no state license for this work)
license.note: Base city Columbus (Grove City). Ohio has no state license for partition installation. Dayton publishes registered-contractor lists only for electrical, heating, pipe laying and plumbing. There is no general or building contractor list, so the City has no list to check for toilet partition installation. Dayton's FAQ says some minor work 'may need to be done by a City of Dayton licensed contractor' and to call Building Inspection at 937-333-3883 about a specific project. Confirm with the City before work starts.
